authority_note: Primary accepted prior CT1 methodology/interpretation/candidate panel in current assignment; historical records retain their original status and bytes. No L1 or L3 authorization.

rank.condition_rule: sigma_max/sigma_min; deficient = null with reason RANK_DEFICIENT (mathematical infinity)
rank.sensitivity: raw plus nominal scaled; one state/input scale at a time x0.1 and x10; continuous tau=0.1,1,10 s

PBH.continuous: full row rank at every eigenvalue Re(lambda)>=0
PBH.discrete: full row rank at every eigenvalue |lambda|>=1
PBH.ambiguous_result: INDETERMINATE; Schur/staircase/residual follow-up, no favorable classification

closed_loop.products: Phi(k,j)=Acl[k-1]...Acl[j]; Phi(j,j)=I; all covered subintervals within original remaining packet
measures: full six-state coupled and conditional scalar speed results

Riccati.denominator: max(1,sum of Frobenius norms of equation terms)
Riccati.on_failure: Preserve original gains; stop affected certificate/reproduction, do not retune

lateral.qualifier: Extract E*A*E^T and E*B[:,delta]; omitted speed/progress and acceleration coupling blocks retained; not assumed invariant.

speed.qualifier: Continuous A_vv=0,B_va=1; use actual discrete entries, not guessed Euler values. Other perturbations frozen is conditional, not coupled-loop pole.

scaling.sensitivity: Every one of n+m scale entries separately x0.1 and x10 with all others fixed; publish dimensional raw matrices too. Continuous tau in [0.1,1,10] s. No perturbation amplitude or controller weight change.

controllability.construct: C=[B,A*B,...,A^(n-1)*B] for n=6,4,1, both dimensional and normalized pairs; continuous use accepted tau.
controllability.method: SVD of C directly, all singular values descending, rank threshold max(1e-12,t_rel*sigma_max), t_rel=[1e-12,1e-10,1e-8,1e-6], default1e-10.
controllability.conditioning: sigma_max/sigma_min with mathematical infinity encoded null+INFINITE_RANK_DEFICIENT; near-zero numerical result is not a theorem of exact deficiency.
controllability.ambiguity: Retain ill-conditioned cases. PBH plus rank-revealing Schur/staircase cross-check before any physical deficiency claim; if not resolved within reviewed methods/budget, INDETERMINATE.
controllability.limitations: Full-rank unconstrained local pair is not constrained nonlinear controllability or reachable-set invariance.

PBH_contract.matrix: [lambda*I-A,B] in complex arithmetic at every eigenvalue; store every singular spectrum and rank across same declared tolerances.
PBH_contract.continuous_required: Re(lambda)>=0 including marginal modes; near imaginary axis within1e-8 -> INDETERMINATE pending residual/Schur/staircase resolution.
PBH_contract.discrete_required: abs(lambda)>=1 including unit circle; within1e-8 of boundary -> INDETERMINATE pending residual/Schur/staircase resolution.
PBH_contract.repeated_modes: No eigenvector inverse; log Schur clusters, eigenvalue residual and conditioning. Ambiguity remains visible, not rounded stable.

gain_verification.primary: Original archived K and gain_times/gain interval source pointers; never substitute recomputed values.
gain_verification.grid: Use original untrimmed 0.01 s gain-generation grid and stored preview/ZOH/control/state sampling; preserve original last grid point used for terminal DARE.
gain_verification.terminal: P_M=DARE(A_lat,last,B_delta,last,Q,R); Q=diag(1/0.1^2,1/0.1^2,1/0.5^2,1),R=1/0.2^2. Not the separate NMPC baseline-design terminal schedule.
gain_verification.checks: Accepted residual/symmetry/positive-definiteness/condition/gain reproduction criteria copied verbatim above. No invalid terminal solve replaced by a different regularized DARE.
gain_verification.suffix_support: To audit selected gain and later gains, compute original index suffix from bound gain index through last original sample; backwards recursion needs its terminal support. No preceding unneeded gain samples.
gain_verification.sample_cap: Count requested suffix grid slots across all 12 candidates before any cross-candidate deduplication; <=960 total, <=80 per candidate; cap applies before matrix evaluation. Extra off-grid work may not silently enlarge grid.
gain_verification.failure: Riccati/gain mismatch -> FAILED_COMPARISON with original gain retained and affected reproduction/stability conclusion withheld.

authority_and_products.DESIGN_SUPPORT_ONLY: Original nominal/gain-grid suffix belongs to original packet design interval [timestamps[0],expiry), possibly after supersession. Needed for DARE/backward audit; not evidence of ongoing accepted authority.
authority_and_products.OBSERVED_AUTHORITY: Products default to intersection of original gain intervals with [anchor_time,min(original expiry, recorded authority end, observed coverage end)). Never cross packet replacement, expiry, gain/input discontinuity by extrapolation.
authority_and_products.mapping: At physical sample time use exact original packet sampling and stored ZOH gain index; trimmed acceptance anchors may be off-grid. If exact actual-duration Jacobian is not among reviewed six maps, report UNAVAILABLE for that event interval; do not substitute a10ms map at a shorter duration.
authority_and_products.conditional_product: Original design-grid Phi may be reported separately with authority_scope=DESIGN_CONDITIONAL and interval entirely inside original nominal/gain validity, never as observed asynchronous evolution. Review this labeling at L2; actual-authority crossing cannot be hidden.
authority_and_products.order: Phi(j,j)=I;Phi(k,j)=Acl[k-1]...Acl[j], chronological new factors multiply on LEFT. Store exact index/time interval and list of source gains.
authority_and_products.measures: All covered subinterval scaled/raw 2-norms, endpoint gain, max transient/time to peak; windows0.01,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4s and remaining only when actually covered. No new tau in discrete closed-loop poles.
authority_and_products.normalization_sensitivity: Repeat each individual state scale x0.1/x10 for products using coordinate similarity; no gain retuning. Raw SI norm explicitly unit-dependent.
authority_and_products.resource: Stream products and bounded peak summaries; if truncated, completed interval/index bounds plus explicit missing ranges. Log rescaling/QR factors and numerical underflow/overflow, never replace an unfavorable product.

closed_loop.full: Acl_full=Ad-Bd*G using same nominal tuple/map and archived gain; actual-held tuple versions separately labeled conditional frozen feedback.
closed_loop.speed: dot(ev)=-kp*ev+r_nom*ew+vy_nom*er+defect_v; expose coupled entries and defects, no PI integral.
closed_loop.progress: Frozen kappa A s-column=0, ideal discrete G ignores s => unit progress-offset multiplier structurally; do not confuse possible progress controllability with regulated progress stability. Physical kappa_s coupling may differ.
closed_loop.poles: Complex values plus eigenvector residual ||Acl*v-lambda*v||/(max(1,||Acl||)*||v||); no new residual pass threshold. Report large/residual-sensitive/near-circle cases indeterminate using accepted1e-8 boundary band.
closed_loop.certification: Each frozen Schur-stable matrix does not establish stability of a varying product. Finite amplification/contraction does not establish uniform exponential/asymptotic nonlinear stability.

nominal_defects.definition: d[k]=F(x_nom[k],u_nom[k])-x_nom[k+1], with matching physical time interval, ZOH u/kappa policy and lifted heading; raw units and scaled vector retained.
nominal_defects.reference_semantics: Original packet linear state interpolation versus 100ms shooting nodes; 10ms tracker map and 100ms NMPC map different; only compare next nominal state at actual map endpoint and within validity.
nominal_defects.decomposition: Report fixed-preview symbolic defect, geometry-dependent physical defect and their difference at identical nominal tuple. Separate racing pseudo-reference inconsistency, preview-versus-track curvature and interpolation. No unique causal attribution to feedback without an appropriate comparative experiment.
nominal_defects.forcing: e_next=Acl*e+d at first order; forced response=sum_i Phi(k,i+1)*d_i with exact covered times and indices. Never drop nonzero d to claim zero-error invariance.
nominal_defects.authority: Reference jumps/packet replacement are events, not smooth d across a different packet. Emit discontinuity and truncate prior-packet product.

applicability_rule: Open-loop derivative validity is separate from full-feedback applicability. Always label ideal unsaturated immediate A-BK as conditional if any relevant flag; no augmented event-map implementation, asynchronous system stability certificate or optimization analysis in this allowlist.
